Featured processing configuration

From the ground.To greater possibilities.

Explore an integrated cassava flour processing configuration, bringing together cleaning, washing, drying, milling and packaging systems.

400-ton

Reference proposal presented as a project concept. It is not a completed, commissioned or Smarctek-owned project, and the time basis of the 400-ton figure is not stated.

Explore cassava processing

01

Cleaning & washing

The reference proposal lists a complete cleaning and washing unit. Its machine list is not itemised there, so scope is defined with the project.

Equipment list is defined with the project scope.

02

Drying

A complete drying unit is part of the reference line. Dryer type and capacity are not itemised in the proposal and are set per project.

Equipment list is defined with the project scope.

03

Grinding & milling

The grinding unit combines breaking, roller milling and sifting, supported by pneumatic conveying, filtration and feeding equipment.

Equipment in the reference configuration (indicative)

  • Industrial Breaker
  • Pneumatic Roller Mill
  • Quadro Plansifter
  • Super Sonic Filter
  • Pneumatic Fan

04

Material handling

Screw conveyors, bucket elevators and discharge units move product between the units of the line. Routing, intake layout and feeding are set in the project diagram.

Equipment in the reference configuration (indicative)

  • Bucket Elevator
  • Flour Conveyor
  • Rotoflow

05

Packaging

Finished flour is weighed and bagged in 25–50 kg units. The single-station machine is listed as an alternative item in the reference proposal.

Equipment in the reference configuration (indicative)

  • Flour Packaging Machine
  • PLC Control Panels

Simplified overview. Equipment mapping is indicative and the final line layout is subject to technical confirmation.
